distance_trilateration_from_current_exac.purpose: Staging-only coordinate recovery when exact business listing exposes distance but not raw lat/lon.
procedure: Query the same exact business listing from at least three known nearby centers.
Solve the 2D distance equations for an inferred WGS84 candidate.
Query again centered on the inferred coordinate and require the exact same business/place ID to return within 0-3 m.
Keep precision as site_centroid_candidate and do not claim verified entrance.
Do not canonicalize without final review against current repo state and duplicate/conflict guards.
